name: xero-multi-entity-consolidation
description: Use for questions across several Xero organisations like "combine our Xero companies", "group P&L across all our Xero entities", "consolidated balance sheet for the group", "how is the group doing across our Xero organisations", "eliminate intercompany between our Xero entities", or "put our UK and US Xero books in one currency" — even when the user never says "consolidation". Use when the decision needs one set of group numbers from two or more Xero organisations. Xero only, wholly owned entities; for QuickBooks use quickbooks-multi-entity-consolidation.
